en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph of a large historic brick building with towers and steep roofs beside a canal or body of water. Trees and a quay are visible in the foreground, with the building reflected in the water. At the top left is printed Dutch text. In the center a blank hinged flap or card is mounted, partly covering the picture, with a small metal fastener on the right.
